visualCharacteristics.purpose: Pull quote / testimonial with optional attribution
visualCharacteristics.description: default: centered navy italic quote (22-28px) on a light surface band with a bold grey attribution. banner: full-width dark slate #474c55 band with upright white ~26px centered text, typically no attribution.

contentPattern.structure: row 1 = quote (rich text); row 2 = attribution (plain text, optional; omitted when empty). Style select (classes) picks the option.

usage.description: Chemistry page (default testimonial); Remote Services and Diagnostics page (banner tagline).

reuseGuidance: Use for a single standalone quote or tagline. Use banner for a full-width statement band without attribution. Use hero or default content for headings with CTAs.
